title: ReactOS Distro Variables
description: Configuration variables for ReactOS modular distribution synthesis and media generation.

REACTOS_DISTRO_VERSION.description: Target ReactOS release or channel version synthesized by reactos-distro.

REACTOS_DISTRO_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading a custom ReactOS BootCD or LiveCD ISO/ZIP archive.

REACTOS_DISTRO_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying upstream ReactOS releases.

REACTOS_DISTRO_FETCH_BASE.description: Set to '1' to download and unpack full upstream ReactOS ISO archives when online.

REACTOS_VERSION.description: Target ReactOS version passed to base and kernel synthesis scripts.

REACTOS_BUILD_FROM_SOURCE.description: Set to '1' to compile ReactOS from REACTOS_SRC_DIR via RosBE instead of repacking upstream ISOs.

REACTOS_SRC_DIR.description: Path to a local ReactOS git checkout used when REACTOS_BUILD_FROM_SOURCE=1.

REACTOS_QEMU_BAKE.description: Set to '1' to execute headless QEMU Stage-1/Stage-2 unattended installation when generating disk images.

LIBSCRIPT_REACTOS_MIRROR.description: Base mirror URL for official ReactOS release BootCD and LiveCD archives.

LIBSCRIPT_REACTOS_NIGHTLY_URL.description: Direct override URL for fetching a ReactOS i686 or x86_64 nightly ISO/7z archive.
